DebayerBypassBlackLevel.blurb: When true on Xray (Vector 2.0), skips BlackLevelAndNormalize in the NEON RAW10 debayer (no subtract-6 / ×255/256 crush). Live immediately — do not call ResetGamma. Default false = stock Xray behaviour.
DebayerBypassBlackLevel.detail: Registered in coretech/vision/engine/debayer/neon/raw10.cpp. Early-return beside IsXray() inside BlackLevelAndNormalize so all NEON scales share one gate. Session B A/B: freeze exposure, toggle this, compare brightness/green. Does not affect the CPU PHOTO path (no black-level there). Category Vision.Debayer.
DebayerBypassBlackLevel.howTo: 1) Same dark scene as baseline. 2) Set DebayerBypassBlackLevel true via consolevars or /consolevarset. 3) Screenshot vs bypass false. 4) Set false when done.

ManualWB_R.blurb: Commanded red software-WB gain for ApplyManualWhiteBalance (default 1.0, range 0.25–3.8). Slider alone does not change pixels — run Apply. Sensor AWB is intentionally pinned to 1,1,1.
ManualWB_R.detail: Software WB path (not VicOS). Pair with ManualWB_G/B. Apply enables in-engine saturating R/G/B multiply after debayer; overlay shows these gains.

ManualWB_G.blurb: Commanded green software-WB gain for ApplyManualWhiteBalance (default 1.0, range 0.25–3.8). Slider alone does not change pixels. Sensor AWB is intentionally pinned to 1,1,1.

ManualWB_B.blurb: Commanded blue software-WB gain for ApplyManualWhiteBalance (default 1.0, range 0.25–3.8). Slider alone does not change pixels. Sensor AWB is intentionally pinned to 1,1,1.

ManualCameraControlLock.blurb: When true, VisionComponent::UpdateCameraParams skips pushing AE/WB from vision results to the camera. Set true by ApplyManualWhiteBalance; clear with ClearManualCameraControlLock.
ManualCameraControlLock.detail: Guards against VisionScheduleMediator re-scheduling AutoExp/WhiteBalance from vision_config defaults after EnableMode(false).

ApplyManualWhiteBalance.blurb: Applies ManualWB_R/G/B to **pixels** via in-engine SoftwareWhiteBalance multiply after debayer. Overlay shows those gains; sensor AWB is intentionally pinned to 1,1,1. Disables AutoExp+WhiteBalance and sets ManualCameraControlLock. Required after changing ManualWB_* sliders.
ApplyManualWhiteBalance.detail: CONSOLE_FUNC Vision.PreProcessing. SetAndDisableCameraControl with ManualWB for overlay, then CameraSetWhiteBalanceParameters(1,1,1), then SoftwareWhiteBalance::SetGains + SetEnabled(true). Honour-test triples: (1,1,1), (2,1,1), (1,1,2). Judge by image colour.
ApplyManualWhiteBalance.howTo: 1) Set ManualWB_R/G/B. 2) Call ApplyManualWhiteBalance. 3) Watch colour for several seconds (lock holds; pixels should shift). 4) ClearManualCameraControlLock when done.

ClearManualCameraControlLock.blurb: Disables software WB (gains 1,1,1), clears ManualCameraControlLock, and re-enables AutoExp + WhiteBalance after a manual WB test. Sensor AWB stays the daemon path after unlock.
ClearManualCameraControlLock.howTo: Call after ApplyManualWhiteBalance trials. Confirm ManualCameraControlLock is false and colour returns toward stock.

SoftwareWBAuto.blurb: When true, gray-world WB gains are applied in-engine (SoftwareWhiteBalance) and VicOS AWB is pinned to 1,1,1. Default false. Enable only after R/B display fix A/B (ManualWB_R should look red in vizManager).
SoftwareWBAuto.detail: VisionSystem::UpdateCameraParams: ScopedIdentity + InvalidateRGB for uncorrected stats; hold-last-good on TooDark or low well-exposed count; clamp to SoftwareWBMinGain/MaxGain. Manual Apply lock still overrides.
SoftwareWBAuto.howTo: 1) Confirm ManualWB T1 red / T2 blue after display fix flash. 2) Clear manual lock. 3) Set SoftwareWBAuto true. 4) Well-lit then dark scenes — gains should not slam 3.8 in the dark.

SoftwareWBMinWellExposed.blurb: Minimum well-exposed subsampled pixels required to update auto software WB (default 100). Below this, hold last gains.

SoftwareWBMinGain.blurb: Min clamp for auto software WB R/B gains (default 0.5). Not the analog 0.25–3.8 rail.

SoftwareWBMaxGain.blurb: Max clamp for auto software WB R/B gains (default 2.5). Avoids slamming the old 3.8 analog rail.
